workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation runtime outcome IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority can consume supplied runtimeOutcome facts through its validation proof chain, but it has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room implementation that derives those runtime outcome facts from supplied public-safe runtime selection facts.

splitDecision.reason: Runtime outcome fact shaping from supplied public-safe selection facts is smaller than runtime validation execution and can be tested without starting LabVIEWCLI, Docker, compare execution, live terminal proof, packaging, Marketplace, release, or launcher/profile mutation.
